metadata.description: Static digitized curves from the named 3GPP calibration workbooks. They are external references, not outputs generated by the Sionna calibration driver.

reference_standard_by_phase.spatial_consistency_config2_metric1_2: 3GPP TR 38.901 v14.0.0 Table 7.8-5 Config2 contribution workbook

provenance.recorded_evidence: contribution identifiers and source workbook filenames

value_conventions.historical_path_gain: Workbook curves historically labelled Coupling Loss contain negative dB x-values; the values are preserved without sign transformation under the truthful historical_path_gain key.
value_conventions.historical_wideband_sir: The Table 7.8-5 Config2 workbook curve is interference-only SIR and is not a noise-inclusive SINR reference.
